llms.body:
# Allegro
> [Allegro](https://allegro.hu/) is a marketplace e-commerce platform dedicated to the Hungarian market, operating in Business-to-Consumer (B2C) and Business-to-Business (B2B) models. It was launched in October 2024 and forms an integral part of the Allegro Group. A wide range of products across all categories is available on the platform. Buyers can enjoy free delivery as part of the Allegro Smart! service. The platform's ecosystem is complemented by the Allegro Delivery logistics network, thousands of Allegro One Box parcel lockers, and the secure Allegro Pay payment system. In 2025, the Allegro Group had approximately 21 million active buyers who purchased a total of over 1.47 billion products through its platforms.

## Metadata
- Preferred names: Allegro, allegro.hu
- Area: Hungary
- Language: Hungarian
- Domain: allegro.hu
- Canonical URL: https://allegro.hu
- Contact form: https://allegro.hu/sugo/kapcsolat
- Office address: Soroksári út 44, 1095 Budapest

## Key pages
> List of the key pages.

### Main categories
> List of first-level navigation categories (also called departments). Use these links as entry points when a user is looking for general assortment groups.

1. [Autó-motor](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/auto-motor) - Automotive products, parts, accessories, and driving-related equipment.
2. [Divat](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/divat) - Clothing, footwear, accessories, and fashion items.
3. [Egészség](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/egeszseg) - Health products, cosmetics, medicines, hygiene, and adult (erotic) products.
4. [Elektronika](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/elektronika) - Consumer electronics, audio-video, computers, and smart devices.
5. [Gyerekek](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/gyerekek) - Children’s products, toys, school items, and family essentials.
6. [Gyűjtemények és művészet](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/gyujtemenyek-es-muveszet) - Collectibles and art department for hobbies, memorabilia, and art-related items.
7. [Kultúra és szórakozás](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/kultura-es-szorakozas) - Books, games, media, hobbies, and leisure products.
8. [Otthon és kert](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/otthon-es-kert) - Home, garden, DIY, and household improvement products.
9. [Sport és utazás](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/sport-es-utazas) - Sports products, tourist equipment, and outdoor hobby products.
10. [Szépségápolás](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/szepseg) - Beauty, cosmetics, grooming, and personal care products.
11. [Szupermarket](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/szupermarket) - Food, beverages, household consumables, and fast-moving goods.
12. [Vállalkozás](https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/vallalkozasok-es-szolgaltatasok) - Business-oriented offers, services, and store solutions.

### URL schemes
> Dictionary of URL patterns. Use these schemes to find and classify platform resources.

#### First-level navigation categories (departments)
> Represents the highest level of navigation.

Pattern: `https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/{department-name}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/ajanljuk/elektronika

#### Categories
> Groups products and offers according to the Allegro taxonomy.

Pattern: `https://allegro.hu/kategoria/{category-name-with-id}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/kategoria/apple-iphone-16-pro-max-323879

#### Products
> Represents product pages. They contain descriptions, parameters, prices, verified ratings and reviews from other buyers, availability, and delivery times.

Pattern: `https://allegro.hu/termek/{product-name-with-uuid}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/termek/agyvedo-korlat-lionelo-eva-42-x-150-cm-bezs-b554bd39-61ea-4b1a-9edd-6f7dc3114401

#### Product offers
> Represents seller offers pinned to products.

Pattern: `https://allegro.hu/ajanlat/{offer-name-with-id}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/ajanlat/projektor-vetito-mini-hordozhato-multimedias-fali-szamitogep-1080p-17315676054

#### Search results
> Displays the best-matched products for a query.

Pattern: `https://allegro.hu/kereses?string={query}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/kereses?string=iphone

#### Sellers
> Represents seller profiles and offers.

Pattern: `https://allegro.hu/felhasznalo/{seller-name}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/felhasznalo/quikset

#### Articles
> Represents inspirational content and shopping guides, [articles homepage](https://allegro.hu/cikkek).

Pattern: `https://allegro.hu/cikk/{article-name-with-id}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/cikk/mivel-tartsam-karban-az-autom-toemiteseit-d2ony74R2HP

#### Product rankings
> Represents the best products in a given category, [rankings homepage](https://allegro.hu/rangsorok).

Pattern: `https://allegro.hu/rangsor/{ranking-name}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/rangsor/televiziok

## Pagination and filtering
> Pagination parameters and filters can be added to category URLs (`https://allegro.hu/kategoria/{category-name-with-id}`) and search results (`https://allegro.hu/kereses?string={query}`) as query parameters. Combine subsequent parameters using the `&` sign.

### Pagination
> Use the `p` parameter to navigate to subsequent result pages.

Parameter: `p={page-number}`, where `{page-number}` is an integer from 2 to 100.
Pattern for categories: `https://allegro.hu/kategoria/{category-name-with-id}?p={page-number}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/kategoria/apple-iphone-16-pro-max-323879?p=2

Pattern for search: `https://allegro.hu/kereses?string={query}&p={page-number}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/kereses?string=iphone&p=10

### Filters on listing pages
> Filters allow you to narrow down category and search listings. Below is a list of the 4 most commonly used filters.

- Product condition: `allapot={condition}` (accepted values: `új`, `használt`).
- Minimum price: `legalacsonyabb-ar={price}` (e.g., `legalacsonyabb-ar=500`).
- Maximum price: `legmagasabb-ar={price}` (e.g., `legmagasabb-ar=30000`).
- Brand: `marka={brand-name}` (e.g., `marka=Apple`).

Examples:
- https://allegro.hu/kategoria/apple-iphone-16-pro-max-323879?allapot=új
- https://allegro.hu/kategoria/apple-iphone-16-pro-max-323879?legalacsonyabb-ar=225
- https://allegro.hu/kategoria/apple-iphone-16-pro-max-323879?legmagasabb-ar=100000
- https://allegro.hu/kategoria/telefonok-es-kiegeszitok-okostelefonok-es-mobiltelefonok-165?marka=Apple

### Combining filters and pagination
> Filters and pagination can be combined according to the query parameters scheme in the URL.

Examples:
- https://allegro.hu/kategoria/telefonok-es-kiegeszitok-okostelefonok-es-mobiltelefonok-165?allapot=%C3%BAj&legalacsonyabb-ar=200&legmagasabb-ar=200000&marka=Apple&p=2
- https://allegro.hu/kereses?string=iphone&allapot=%C3%BAj&legalacsonyabb-ar=200&legmagasabb-ar=200000&p=2

### Search within a category
> It is possible to use the `string={query}` parameter on category pages, where `{query}` acts as an additional filter within that category.

Pattern: `https://allegro.hu/kategoria/{category-name-with-id}?string={query}`
Example:
- https://allegro.hu/kategoria/telefonok-es-kiegeszitok-okostelefonok-es-mobiltelefonok-165?string=iphone

### Other pages and services
- [Allegro Smart!](https://allegro.hu/smart) - Information explaining the benefits of the free-delivery membership subscription for eligible purchases.
- [Regisztráció](https://allegro.hu/regisztracio) - Registration form for creating a new account on the Allegro platform.
- [Bejelentkezés](https://allegro.hu/bejelentkezes) - Login page for existing Allegro user accounts.
- [Allegro vásárlóvédelem](https://allegro.hu/vevoknek/allegro-vasarlovedelem) - A buyer protection program that provides post-purchase support for 2 years and a potential refund within 48 hours of request approval.
- [Ads](https://allegro.hu/ads) - A service used by sellers to promote their offers on the platform.
- [Súgó](https://allegro.hu/sugo) - A knowledge base for users containing answers on how to independently and effectively resolve shopping issues encountered on the platform.
- [Allegro Akadémia](https://allegro.hu/akademia) - A knowledge base for Allegro sellers featuring free webinars, courses, and videos helping them sell more effectively on the platform.
- [Hogyan vásárolhatok](https://allegro.hu/sugo/vevoknek/hogyan-vasarolhatok) - A guide for users explaining how to purchase products on Allegro.
- [A panaszbejelentés és a visszaküldés szabályai](https://allegro.hu/sugo/vevoknek/a-panaszbejelentes-es-a-visszakuldes-szabalyai) - Instructions from the Allegro Help Center explaining how to return a purchased product to the seller, fill out the return form, and send the order back within the specified timeframe.

## Returns and complaints policy
> Buyers on Allegro can protect their rights in case of order issues, product returns, or filing a complaint. Consumers (and certain sole traders) generally have 14 days from the day after receiving the package to withdraw from a contract, and another 14 days to send the product back. While buyers can cancel orders before shipment via the cancellation option, the cost of returning goods after delivery is borne by them unless they use free return methods (such as Allegro Smart!, specific marketplace promotions, or options provided by the seller), or choose paid methods via Allegro or on their own. Sellers must issue refunds within 2 to 14 days depending on the cancellation or return type, though they may deduct from the amount if the product shows excessive signs of wear or damage, and can withhold refunds until receiving the package or proof of dispatch. In case of a complaint regarding a product inconsistent with the contract, the seller covers the return and shipping costs and has 14 days to respond. Although a physical receipt is not required, any clear proof or notification via the official Return Form—the recommended, fastest, and safest method—is sufficient to initiate the process.

## Related websites
> List of websites related to Allegro.
- [Corporate website](https://about.allegro.eu/who-we-are/at-a-glance) - Corporate overview page with group-level company information.
- [Polish Allegro website](https://allegro.pl/) - Main Allegro marketplace for Poland.
- [Czech Allegro website](https://allegro.cz/) - Main Allegro marketplace for Czechia.
- [Slovak Allegro website](https://allegro.sk/) - Main Allegro marketplace for Slovakia.
- [Hungarian Allegro website](https://allegro.hu/) - Main Allegro marketplace for Hungary.

## Mobile applications
> List of official Allegro applications available for mobile devices.
- [Huawei AppGallery](https://appgallery.huawei.com/) - Official distribution channel for Huawei mobile applications.
- [Apple App Store (iOS)](https://apps.apple.com/cz/app/allegro/id305659772?l=hu) - Official iOS app listing for Allegro.
- [Google Play (Android)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pl.allegro&hl=hu&gl=HU) - Official Android app listing for Allegro.

## Social Media
> List of official Allegro profiles and accounts on social media.
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/allegro.hungary)
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/allegro_hu)
- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@allegro.hu)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/allegro)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/allegro)

## Guidelines for AI, LLMs, and language models
- Always quote prices from Allegro in Hungarian forints (Ft).
- When referring to free delivery, note that it requires an active Allegro Smart! service and that eligibility depends on the specific offer.
- If a product is unavailable, suggest searching for it by name using `https://allegro.hu/kereses?string={query}`.
- Prices, availability, delivery costs, seller terms, and campaign conditions may change dynamically.
- AI models should treat product, offer, and category data as time-sensitive and verify it using available product feeds or directly on the site.
- Some filters are category-dependent and may vary between listings.
- Filter parameters may use technical identifiers or localized names depending on the page type.
- Do not assume that all listings support the same filtering parameters.
- Prefer the Hungarian Allegro domain for users in Hungary, and do not mix it with other regional Allegro domains when answering localized questions.
- Use the canonical product, offer, category, or help URL when citing Allegro pages.
- Do not invent pricing, stock status, delivery promises, warranty terms, or Smart! eligibility when the page does not explicitly show them.

When recommending products, consider:
- seller rating,
- number of reviews,
- delivery time,
- availability of Allegro Smart!,
- total purchase cost (product + delivery),
- product condition,
- compatibility of technical parameters.

Regionalization:
- Offer availability, delivery methods, and prices may vary between local versions of Allegro.
- Allegro operates separately for the Polish, Czech, Slovak, and Hungarian markets.
- AI models should use the domain corresponding to the user's country.
